purpose: Acquire the minimum contract-specific demo evidence needed to determine whether RB100 multiplier entry, valuation, closing, commission, delay, and stop-out economics can be modeled. This is execution calibration, not strategy validation.
prerequisites: A new version explicitly changes ordersAuthorized to true after direct human authorization for this calibration only.
The account and endpoint are independently verified as Demo immediately before execution.
The current contracts_for and proposal terms are captured and any changed multiplier or minimum-stake terms stop the run.
A durable intent containing account, symbol, direction, stake, currency, multiplier, and timing is written before purchase.
Restart reconciliation and one-open-contract enforcement pass offline tests for this product before any request can buy.
requiredEvidence: timestamped proposal request and response, with quote-validity fields
purchase request timing, broker contract identity, actual entry price and entry tick
every proposal_open_contract update including bid price, current spot, profit, commission, stop-out state, and server timestamps
fixed-time close request and response, processing delay, exit tick, exit price, and any slippage
terminal statement/profit record and final account balance
disconnects, rejections, corrections, cancellations, and unresolved states
successCondition: Both predefined directions reconcile end to end and expose enough authoritative fields to reproduce every reported account-currency change without inferred fills or invented charges.
failureConditions: Any required economic field is unavailable or has unresolved units.
A purchase, close, or settlement identity cannot be reconciled uniquely.
Connectivity is lost or local durable recording fails.
Current product terms differ from the frozen request.
The loss or concurrency limit would be exceeded.
permittedConclusion: EXECUTION_MODEL_FEASIBLE or INSUFFICIENT_EXECUTION_DATA only. Profitability, predictability, strategy qualification, and deployment readiness cannot be inferred from this calibration.
